description: For chain=[leaf, CA], revocation.check_revocation is called for leaf only. At i=chain.len()-1, chain.get(i+1) is None so the cert directly issued by the trust anchor is never checked. For a typical 2-cert [leaf, intermediate-CA] chain, the intermediate CA could be revoked and verify_chain returns Ok. This is documented in the function doc but as a footnote, not a Security warning. The doc says 'out of scope for v0.1' but the consequence is that CRL/OcspChecker callers who think they have full-chain revocation are silently unprotected for the CA cert. Risk: users who configure CrlChecker or OcspChecker expect it to cover all certs in the chain. The maintenance consequence: issue reports from users who correctly configured revocation checking and still accepted a revoked CA cert.
title: verify_chain skips revocation for last cert in chain
